name: Beyondronpa: Manufactured Error
source:
Skyler Ohdo, The Ultimate Imposter faces off against his siblings and his father in this death game inspired by The Danganronpa series. Try to figure out who killed who while uncovering the secrets of your family. Can you survive long enough to uncover the truth?

[From [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/Beyondronpa/720063]Game Jolt[/url]]
translation:
在这场受《弹丸论破》系列启发的死亡游戏中，超高校级的冒名者Skyler Ohdo，将与手足及父亲对峙。一边揭开家族秘密，一边找出究竟是谁杀了谁。你能活到真相大白的那一刻吗？

[摘自[url=https://gamejolt.com/games/Beyondronpa/720063]Game Jolt[/url]]
